lede: The Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer is the one story every feed agrees on: 20,902,062 views on YouTube, a top Google Trends query in Britain, and a GTA title climbing Steam, all on the same day. Behind it, a new open model called Muse Spark Open sat at number one on Hacker News with 713 points and surfaced on Hugging Face at the same time. The quietest surprise was on Wikipedia, where the GBU-43/B MOAB drew 453,110 readers and beat the next article by only about 25,000.

throughlines.title: gta vi launch trailer
throughlines.gist: The trailer turned up on Google Trends, Steam, and YouTube at once, where its 20,902,062 views made it the day's clear crossover story.

throughlines.title: Muse Spark Open
throughlines.gist: A newly released open model topped Hacker News at 713 points while appearing on Hugging Face, the rare item the tech and model feeds shared.

throughlines.title: GBU-43/B MOAB
throughlines.gist: The munition was Wikipedia's most-read article at 453,110 views, edging the runner-up by only about 25,000 with nothing else in the snapshot to explain the spike.
